Vampire Survivors is a minimalist survival game built around one goal: stay alive long enough for your run to snowball into something ridiculous. It looks simple at first, but it’s engineered to keep you chasing the next “perfect” build.

Just make sure your device can handle it; my iPad Pro from 2016 begins to get bogged down towards the latter 10 minutes of each run due to the number of objects on the screen, weapon interactions, etc.

reviews.title: Great value, addictive, tons of secrets: the perfect mobile game
reviews.text:

It’s just a few dollars + extra for the DLC and that’s SO refreshing in a sea of free to play and microtransactions. There are loads of secrets and unlockables that you’ll come across, though you might need a guide to keep some things straight because there are just so many little things in the game. …just be careful not to minimize out of the game for too long because it will reset after too long.

reviews.title: Faithful port, absolutely perfect monetisation
reviews.text:

The monetisation of this game is a shining beacon in the dark land of modern mobile gaming, no forced ads whatsoever, no subscriptions, no microtransactions for cosmetics or resources, just the free base game and the (very) cheaply priced DLCs, which are absolutely worth their modest price.

reviews.title: It Scratches That Itch
reviews.text:
You know the feeling: One more round. One more try to outrun the boss. One more attempt to get that item upgrade. Vampire Survivors delivers on every front. It is the perfect arcade game. 

Its controls are simple, but it hits that sweet spot of challenging gameplay (but not impossible) and the promise of more to explore and uncover. The number of hidden items, easter eggs, and unlockable enhancements makes this tiny game worth it. 

Don’t let its jagged pixel graphics and 8-bit era music and sound put you off — this game is highly addictive and has immense replay value. While it’s no Elden Ring, it is still as satisfying as only the best games can be. Vampire Survivors is a must for anyone looking for a classic and intense video game experience.

I love how the mobile version is free; what would be a hilarious way to poke further fun at cash-grabs is a means to pay for or discount the DLC by watching a series of ads given its already low price, with a counter or progression bar showing how many more ads until completion.

I hope to see more improvements to both the pc and mobile versions, full of even more references to such games as Final Fantasy and Castlevania, with perhaps new references to things like Touhou or Metal Gear.

I only have a single complaint, and that's that the on-screen joystick isn't actually analog--you can only move at full speed or not move at all, which can make the game a bit difficult to play especially once my character starts getting really fast.

Until that's fixed, I'll still be playing it on PC, but this is still a great way to spend some time if I only have my phone on me.

reviews.text:
I really like this game, but the problem is that when you’re in the final minutes and there’s a million things on the screen, your character gets covered with weapons, things exploding, etc, and it also covers enemies - then all of a sudden you’re dead and you never saw what killed you. This needs to be fixed.

Another strange thing is that the levels aren’t mapped as in other games, so if you leave something and come back for it later, it’s no longer there. The game seems to add enemies and power ups just off screen. I personally would rather have a finite playing field with static power ups

reviews.title: The real Vampire Survivors
reviews.text: Thank you Poncle for bringing the REAL Vampire Survivors to iOS. I love this game so much that I play it every day on steam and now I can finally play it on iOS. This isn’t a 3rd party clone of vampire survivors that has been on the App Store but the real Vampire Survivors! I am so grateful that this has been ported to iOS! So far I haven’t run into any ads, but regardless please add a way to donate to you for this amazing game! There are no micro-transactions, no stamina that limits how much you can play, all of the ads are optional and unobtrusive, and it plays amazing with a touch screen. This is how mobile games should be! Thank you again Poncle!!!

reviews.title: One of the best
reviews.text:
This game is just fantastic not only is it free the game is it gets more fun and more fun where you play. The amount accountant that you get with the game is crazy. Thank you so much. I have spent countless hours playing and I plan to spend many more if possible.
 If I had to complain about something or ask for something, it would be to move the pause button. For some reason on my iPhone 12 Pro Max I have to hit the button multiple times, and sometimes I end up getting hit. it’s really not a complaint regardless of that. Thank you again for the awesome game.

reviews.title: Amazing but encountering a bug
reviews.text:
So, Vampire Survivors is genuinely the best mobile port of a game you could possibly ask for. Arriving for *free*, with the entire vanilla game, no ads, no pay to win, just the complete 1.0 package? INCREDIBLE. One of the few games to make me feel like buying DLC is worth it too. 

Unfortunately, Ode to Castlevania is currently unstable on my device (ipad mini 4th Gen) and keeps crashing well before reaching the 30 minute mark or dying. I really hope this is just an optimization problem you guys are able to fix soon! Love your game, and would really like to enjoy the new DLC in full!

reviews.title: The One and Only.
reviews.text:
I’ve spent over 100 hours playing this on Steam. I’d forgotten how HARD it is at the beginning! Lol! 

So, basically the point of this game is to break the game and be as over-powered as you possibly can. There’s so many things to unlock, so many funny weird bits of lore, it’s the first game in ages that I found legitimately FUN. There’s so much more to it than it first seems, and all of the clones I tried in the App Store before this was finally released fail to capture that. They get the basics of the gameplay, but none of the Holy Cow, There’s MORE? “Secret” characters, weird levels, it’s just so fun.

reviews.title: Would be amazing but…
reviews.text: You can’t leave the game for anything without risking losing all your progress it seems, and when games can last for 30 minutes having to pause and do something else on your phone is pretty likely. Every time I have to stop and leave the app to answer a text message or look something up i end up back at the start screen and it is infuriating. I honestly love the game, but I stopped playing a year or two ago for this same reason and recently redownloaded it to try it again. I don’t understand why they haven’t added a continue where you left off feature yet. This seems like a critical issue to me…

reviews.title: I absolutely love this game but…
reviews.text: This game deserves an absolute 5 stars. The only thing I wish you could do is create an account to save your data and transfer it to other devices. Currently, all my progress is on my phone, and I'd like to add it to my Xbox, but I can't. If this feature gets added, it would significantly improve the game. A few more weapons would be nice, but it's not necessary as there are already tons of weapons. Thank you, developers, for making this fantastic game. I can't wait to see how far this game goes in the future.

reviews.title: Please fix the iOS version
reviews.text:
I would gladly purchase all of the DLC again on iOS, even though I’ve already purchased all of it on Steam, if the developers would fix one major issue: Vampire Survivors does not reliably stay suspended in the background.

On a phone, this makes the game almost unplayable for me. A run can last a long time, and I’m not going to start one knowing that a phone call, text, or switching to another app could cause the game to lose my progress and force me to restart or continue the entire run.

This is a mobile game. Being able to briefly leave the app and return to the same run should be basic functionality. If this gets fixed, I would happily buy all of the DLC on iOS. Until then, I can’t justify spending more money on this version.

reviews.title: Fantastic Game Without Microtransactions
reviews.text:
I absolutely LOVE this game! It feels so nostalgic despite being a new game, which I credit to the art style, simple game mechanics, and lack of microtransactions. The absence of microtransactions is truly what pushed me to write this review, as it is what made this game stand out to me amongst all the other games.

My boyfriend and I have both put more hours into this game than we have into several of our console and PC games. We’ve cleared all of the achievements and can’t wait for more updates! Big kudos to the development team for this amazing game ❤️

reviews.title: Great Game - Major Flaw
reviews.text:
So at this point there are dozens, if not hundreds of mobile clones to this - a revolutionary retro style game that started an entire genre that seems like it should have existed 20 years ago. 

 Most of those clones are bad. Some are enjoyable. However, even the most basic, rudimentary mobile clone has something this game doesn’t - the ability to close the game and come back. You will play this game for 26 minutes, get a call, and boom all your progress is gone. This was fine on PC because you could just pause and minimize the game. But as a mobile port this feature is an absolute requirement. I can’t give this game 5 stars as its current port.

reviews.title: You need no other survivor game on mobile.
reviews.text: Play it. Not only does the game offer tons of content for free. You can get it all without a dime. Not only this but the developer handled in game ads well. Watch them only to get more gold (which is optional, without it progression is completely balanced) and you can play the entire experience offline. 5/5 game and 5/5 translation to mobile. Only minor complaint is sometimes it will wipe your progress if you pause and leave the game for a while. Unsure if they fixed this in more recent versions.

reviews.title: Great game just possibly one bug
reviews.text:
Spoilers needed to describe the bug:

When unlocking Infernas, I’m able to unlock 8/9 coffins. Moving into the final coffin causes the enemies on screen to die, and projectiles freeze in place, but nothing else happens. When you move away or stay still, enemies begin to spawn in again and projectiles move again. But moving into the coffin causes the same issue (enemies die as if they were killed by pentagram) and projectiles freeze in place. The game is essentially soft locked with the only escape being to die/reset the run.

reviews.title: The most fun you can have on your phone, is free
reviews.text:
This game has hundreds of hours of quality playtime, for free.

The DLC packs have tons of content for prices most people can find affordable.

This is by far the most quality I have ever seen in a mobile game, it's pretty light on battery too!

The devs put time, love and effort into every bit of this. Normally Apple doesn't let you turn your phone upside-down because it makes them more money off of lightning connectors breaking when people lay in bed with their phone, 
    this game just lets you rotate anyway you want in the settings! You want sideways? the game adapts to that! And I applaud whoever made this happen. 

I don't agree with the privacy policy but that's my only gripe, and considering the walled ecosystem of the app store I understand why it's included.

You guys rock! Thank you for giving me a healthy and enjoyable way to kill time when I can.

reviews.title: Ode to Castlevania DLC
reviews.text: Very disappointed in the paid DLC that adds tons of additional content to this game that I am unable to access due to random crashing at any point during an attempted play through of Dracula’s castle map. I have loaded only the single DLC by itself to see if it would help with crashing issues and has yet to work. Anywhere from map load and up to 15 minutes into play through the game will crash. Happens with every character, it’s extremely frustrating and very disappointing to have paid for something you were excited to play because of being such a huge fan off the Castlevania game series. Hoping someone from the dev team actually will read this and attempt to take action to remedy this problem.

reviews.title: Merchant not working
reviews.text: The merchant is completely broken and doesn’t show anything even after unlocking the glass vizard from the secrets menu. When interacting with them prior to force unlocking it the merchant would take gold but not give anything in return and not show anything other than the “Fancy a new Vizard?” message. Other than that bug though the game insanely well optimized barely getting any frame drops even on 60 minute runs on max curse. Looking past this one issue I’ve had with my save it’s an absolutely perfect port.

reviews.title: Great Game, One Major Flaw
reviews.text: I have really enjoyed playing this game and I only have one request which will help me get this to a five star review. This game is on a mobile device and as such, they should have the capability of being interrupted without affecting the current game. Any type of interruption, such as an incoming call, or if you need to step away to do something will result in the game resetting itself and you don’t lose the progress that you have made through that game it does essentially close out that game so my suggestion is to please find a way to help the game progressand allow players to continue where they left off. Thank you.

reviews.title: The crashes are too much
reviews.text:
Tl;dr: I love this game, but I hate the amount of crashes I get throughout my playtime. 

I love this game and want to give it 5 stars, but I just can't at the point I'm at. 
The gameplay is amazing, I've gotten to the 4th stage and I've beat it twice. But, I can't legitimately beat it. The game won't stop crashing over and over again. Granted, I'm on an iPhone 7s, so I might just be outdated. But consistently I'll get to the final 10 minutes, decked out, all my items are what they should be annnd crash. 
It's been a constant problem throughout my time playing. From the first stage onward.

reviews.title: Devs PLEASE fix this
reviews.text: I have been really enjoying this game, I haven’t played too much but I can already say my biggest problem is that whenever you close the app or go to the Home Screen for ANY reason the game you were in the middle of playing immediately wipes itself and any progress you made in your current run is gone forever. I reached level 20 three times to unlock the next area and I had to do it over again several times I would close out of the app periodically. Granted this isn’t an issue when the game is paused but it’s still quite frustrating.

reviews.title: Perfect for Phones, New Favorite App
reviews.text:
Look, I play mobile games sparingly but Vampire Survivors is the best one I have ever played. It's everything mobile gaming could be if it chose to do in a way that respects players. I'm a freelance game reviewer; I've covered probably close to 400 games/hardware in my career. I've written praise about mobile games less than 5 times that I can recall. This is a fantastic experience and I recommend pairing it with music or podcasts, perfect for anyone that struggles to just sit and enjoy audio on its own. 

9.8/10, full review on Forever Classic Games

reviews.title: Heavily Slept on Game
reviews.text:
I recently got this game on Game Pass on my Xbox and was turned away from the graphics and gameplay. Whenever I heard that Vampire Survivors was releasing on mobile via The Game Awards, I decided to give this game a second chance. And oh my, I’m glad I did. The gameplay is rich and deep, complex yet simple and overall so addicting. I find myself binge playing this game for hours on end, grinding to fill the collection tab and finding all the secrets I can. 

I would HIGHLY recommend getting this game and just spending an hour learning how to play.

reviews.title: Absolutely Worth the Download
reviews.text: My first time playing this game was on Xbox Gamepass and I was instantly hooked so I didn’t hesitate to download them both onto my iPhone and iPad. I am very pleased with the iOS version. I prefer to use my Xbox controller on my iPad but the touch controls are easy to work with for anyone I would assume. The gameplay is very fun and addicting. Best of all…no intrusive ads, only if you want a extra life (which you don’t normally get with this game on steam and Xbox.) If I could only keep one game on my phone, undoubtedly it’s Vampire Survivors.

reviews.title: One major bug
reviews.text: Amazing game for free! One major bug I’ve noticed: when area is increased certain weapons act goofy. Instead of increasing the area of the item, it increases the circumference of the range. Example: Santa water upgrade to La Bora. The image is broken when gifted via chest and when active, the circumference is so large that it is off the screen and effectively useless. Holy Bible: instead of the bibles getting larger like on PC, the circumference increases making the bibles farther and farther away from the character. Kind of a goofy bug making some builds useless but overall one of my favorite games currently.

reviews.title: Annoyed
reviews.text: Amazing free to play game especially in the market today, I love it so far. Annoyed bc I had a game going for half an hour, got around 10k gold lvl 100+ and got a few weapon evos I didn't have. Had to go to work so I've had it in the background screen and have just been playing it on breaks. Come back to it now and it's on the menu screen and I lost that whole game and progress. Gave me no achievement that I earned or gold. As if it didn't even happen. Great game. Good enough to get me to write a review out of anger and still give it 5 stars

reviews.title: This game should NOT be on mobile
reviews.text: The mobile release of this game is a HORRIBLE thing, my time is gone now. How am I supposed to be bored in my day to day life when a game like this is in the palm of my hands at any time? How will I play slop mobile games that spam advertisements when a game like this is on my phone? I now have to buy all the DLC’s again because they decided to bring a game that’s already stolen over 100 hours on my computer onto mobile.. I will probably vouch for this game until I die.

reviews.title: Incredible Game, in Need of “Suspend” Function
reviews.text:
This game is utterly addicting and I was thrilled to see it ported to mobile, especially for free. Fun, deep, easy to learn but hard to master, great visuals, great audio, keeps me coming back again and again.

Unfortunately I’ve often briefly switched apps or put my phone to sleep, only to come back and find myself back at the main menu. Runs are up to 30 minutes, and it’s a real bummer starting over after 26 just because I answered a text.

I like the experience of this game on mobile, but it’s frustrating being so close to loving it.

reviews.title: Small issue
reviews.text: I am obsessed with the game thanks Dev for bringing this game to console and mobile I really love it but there is a small problem with the frame rate issue since the weapons get really big and cover the screen with sooo much going on it lags bad to the point I can’t bare it have a feeling that it will crash during the fights like it did once before the same with the console version as well but other then that it’s a perfect game out of 5 stars I would give it a 100/ 5 must play though

reviews.title: They should be charging for this
reviews.text:
Dude it’s rare you find a good game on the App Store, even rarer do you find a game that has no forced ads, and only one micro transaction (for a dlc) you’d usually find something like this on Apple Arcade or behind a paywall but no this is literally just the PC game (which costs money) and yet the mobile version is free, 

I can’t seem to find a way to tip the developers at all but I implore you, download this game, play it and get the dlc, honestly it’s worth your money and the base game will no doubt show you that

reviews.title: One of the Best games on the App Store.
reviews.text: Played this game for about 2 months  whenever I had down time , 100% everything. Loved the Music, Levels, Characters, weapon combos and Easter eggs. Some of the most fun I’ve ever had playing a mobile game ever and first mobile game I’ve ever completed. Ads only play if you wanted 1 extra chance at surviving and it was completely optional. This is a legit fun game can’t wait to see if we get the expansion but I plan on playing again on steam version anyway to also play the DLC. 10/10

reviews.title: The fun and strange mechanics of Vampire Survivors
reviews.text: Vampire Survivors is a lot of fun. I like how the game is designed to make you lose every time so you can upgrade. I also like how it’s not pay 2 win because I HATE those games. Another thing I like about Vampire Survivors is the unique characters where none are alike. If the creators of Vampire Survivors made the game too easy then I wouldn’t be leaving a review or even play the game for that matter. If you are the creator(s) of Vampire Survivors and you read this then I would be grateful.

reviews.title: Can we get more than 30min gameplay
reviews.text: Game is amazing probably one of the best games in my opinion. It’s challenging and rewarding when you get to higher levels. My only gripe is that we only have 30 minutes of gameplay and then the red thing shows up slicing and dicing and you die. Unless you have the time freezing the shield that keeps you alive but you get no more gems. I would to be more progress and higher tier weapons passing the 30 minute mark i have made it to level 98.

reviews.title: Runs smooth now and can handle late stages!
reviews.text:
It’s a great port and NO ADS!! However my only real complaint with the game is sometimes you pause and switch to a different app for over a few minutes, when you return to the game, it just opens from the main menu and you lose all your progress from the game you were just playing.  
It’s incredibly frustrating especially because these games can last for a while. 
Other than that, it’s great!

reviews.title: Love the game but it crashes
reviews.text: I absolutely love this game and have bought the dlc and spent many hours playing. The only issue I have is that it’ll crash in the middle of the run occasionally and I don’t get anything from it, if I crash it’s like the run never existed so any achievements I had going on just dissapear, my breaking point was just now when I was about to evolve the night sword and the base item of a dude for the first time each and it crashed, I was pretty far along into the run so it gets really annoying to lose all of that

reviews.title: Fantastic developer
reviews.text:
The game originated from PC/Steam and sold for a mere 2.50. An absolute bargain for such a well made game. The developer continued throughout this last year to improve and expand the game quite significantly. To find this game on mobile (for free?!?!) Is truly a dream. Thank you Poncle for your generosity and such a well made game! 

Game is easy to pickup but harder to master. Once you get there you will find tons of unlockables and achievements. This game tips it’s hat toward Castlevania as you will find plenty of similar references and mechanics.

reviews.title: Goty
reviews.text: Coming from someone who has a 100% completion of all the current content of the Steam Release, you need to know that this is one of my favorite games of all time. Everything is just so brilliantly made in the original version, and this port is quite literally exactly the same as the original game. No catch. I think everyone should immediately drop that *other* survivors game on Mobile and switch to this. The devs deserve all the love and support in the world.

reviews.title: ignore the low stars, they’re all dumb complaints.
reviews.text: this is a fun, and moreover CHEAP game and a great time waster when you’re bored. so many lame complaints from people tho. one person gave it one star because there’s a dlc link on main page…. like every other game in existence.  after reading thru more of the low stars reviews, they’re all dumb petty stuff like that.  ignore them, unless you also have a low iq or are just a pain in the rear to be around

reviews.title: Love this game; can we please save?
reviews.text: I downloaded this game around 3 months ago and I’ve almost 100% completed the base game already. I love it so much. There is only really one thing missing. I’ve done a bit of programming, so I know things aren’t always as easy as they sound, but a save and continue feature would be so great. The app often unloads in the background and causes me to lose my run. I’ll still play the game even without it, though.

reviews.title: Very repetitive and broken ad revival
reviews.text:
The good is there's a lot of progression and unlocks to achieve/acquire.  Graphics, sound are ok. Movement is kinda slow, even when powered up.
The bad is that the gameplay gets very repetitive and monotonous. Yeah there are new enemies and some treasures to pick up along the way, but it just feels like you're wondering around killing stuff over and over and over.
And don't bother with the ad to revive after dying.  It revives you while the ad is still playing, so you just die again, having watched an ad for nothing. 🤬
Borderline 2-3 stars

reviews.title: Awesome Game!!
reviews.text: I never write reviews on mobile games, but I had to take a second to give this game the review it deserves. After completing the game (all secrets, 131 collectibles, killing all beasts, etc), I can honestly say this is one of the best games I have ever played on a mobile device. The games starts off rather slow, but as soon as you start unlocking other characters, it can get crazy fast! Hoping the DLC comes to mobile devices soon! Great game, deserves 5 stars all day!!

reviews.title: Fun, free and NO ADS??
reviews.text:
Wow sometimes even if it’s to good to be true it can still exist. Sad to see this is the only game to my knowledge that has all three qualities in one package. 

I can say without a doubt this game is 1000% added to my list of “Fantastic mobile games”

Vampire survivor, Terraria, minecraft, baldis basics, solar smash, simple rockets, the powder toy, super hexagon, rymdkapsl, infinity blade, world box. Are the few games that exist on mobile that are worth playing, VS is hands down top of that list.

reviews.title: Great, and the save file issue was fixed
reviews.text: I put off playing this for so long due to its popularity, the in screenshots it didn’t look like much, and I played similar games before and after this released and I didn’t like them much. I heard how generous the mobile version of the game is from a friend (the whole base game is free) so I decided to give it a try. The mobile joystick controls are annoying, but that’s just me. I bought it on pc and play with a controller, it’s way better.

reviews.title: Love this game
reviews.text: Great game, however I am a primarily offline player due to my working circumstance. I played this game religiously for months, maxed out everything in the base game, and decided to buy the DLC. I installed it, and since then it always seems to delete itself off of my phone whenever it gets the chance. Going a long time without service, this is problematic. That has got to be my biggest issue, but other than that this is an incredibly solid game. Please fix this issue!

reviews.title: Genuinely great game!
reviews.text: Vampire survivors is one of the best games (especially for mobile) and has some of the most effort put into it. The amount of content is crazy, I don’t remember playing a game and not unlocking something new at the end. When you buy a dlc you basically get a new story to play though, I also like how buying the dlc don’t just give you everything you have to figure out what you need and how to get it.

reviews.title: Finally!!
reviews.text: I bought this game on steam a couple months ago and I never really got heavily into it just because of its pick up and play nature. If I sat down with it and played it for a while I’d usually switch to something else after a while and wouldn’t come back for a couple days or so…HOWEVER putting this game on mobile is the smartest moves the developers could make. this game suits mobile devices perfectly and is super super fun :)

reviews.title: Best devs in the market
reviews.text:
Other devs should take notes when it comes to designing a mobile game. The game is FREE with little to no ads, which is a RARE feat. Give it a shot and give the devs some love, there’s a reason it’s already rated as high as it is. There are also a good few features in the game which are amazing to have, such as orientation changes and the ability to disable flashing VFX. 

Thank you devs! I know the teams small, but you all are doing great! Cheers

reviews.title: I enjoyed it until DLCs
reviews.text: I loved playing this game, it was enjoyable, fun, addictive, the aesthetic is cool and overall I just loved it! But when I decided to get both of the DLCs, It just stopped working. I tried to play the DLCs but they didn’t work. I just decided to play the normal maps but they also didn’t work. I don’t know what is happening, I know it is a glitch and a BIG GLITCH. I don’t know if this is only happening to me but this glitch needs to be fixed. But before getting the DLCs, I LOVED IT. But now… I still love it!

reviews.title: Crashes
reviews.text:
I enjoy the gameplay and everything, but it constantly crashes it seems to have gotten worse the more I play the game. I am playing on an iPhone 13.

After further testing the chance of crashing is drastically increased with peachone. With it I can’t even get through 15 minutes without crashing. Without it, I can consistently get to the 30 minute mark.

I would test further but that’s all I feel like doing for the time being.

reviews.title: Recent update kills app in background
reviews.text: Good game, enjoy it a lot.  Prior to the last update, I could leave mid-game, do other stuff, then come back to it hours later and I’m still in my play session.  Since the last update, it dies in the background pretty consistently.  Please find some way to save mid-game progress so this isn’t an issue.  Mobile games are supposed to be “pick up, play, put down, pick up, keep playing,” not “… put down, pick up, start over.”

reviews.title: Most amazing take on Freemium Gaming!
reviews.text: While already a fan of the Steam version, I was more than happy to buy this on iOS.  When I saw it was FREE, I was immediately filled with dread, as NOTHING is truly free.  Expecting my beloved game to be ruined with arbitrary timers, 6 resources, and a truckload of IAPs, I was totally surprised by your implementation.  A completely free game with only optional ads for both 1 revive and an option to watch an ad to double the gold you earned on this last run!

reviews.title: Great game, but Apple are thieves
reviews.text:
Amazing game. The game itself is a 10 for me. I’ve played it all the way on multiple platforms because I have that much fun with it. 

Now. This part isn’t the developers fault or the games. Just be forewarned, if you buy the DLC and you’re using apple products, Apple will charge you $7 on top of the extremely reasonable priced dlc. And that’s not just this game. Apple are a bunch of thieves and I regret ever getting an iPhone.

reviews.title: Good but…
reviews.text: It’s really fun and I love this game soooooo much (I LOVE YOU FOR ADDDING THE BALATRO COLLAB) that being said the only reason this game doesn’t get 5 stars is it crashes way too often and im not like putting 5mil gold eggs with 6 evolutions (sometimes) but it’s usually for no reason like I’ll be playing an adventure and I’m like about to meet the requirement for x quest and then it crashes not to say it’s all the time but when it happens it’s rlly annoying pls fix (thank you again for the balatro collab such a 🔥idea)

reviews.title: One minor flaw ruins it for me
reviews.text:
I've loved this game on other platforms and was really excited to find it for the iPad, but there's a tiny flaw with this version that ruins it for my personal use case: in landscape mode it only support one orientation, but not the other.
As a iOS developer myself I know there are no reasons to lock the landscape mode into a single orientation, and the developer here could simply mark the other landscape orientation as available.
Without it I can't play this game most of the time, which is a shame.

reviews.title: One of my favorite games: endless fun, experimentation, and creativity
reviews.text:
But unfortunately I cannot give this version 5 stars due to one single thing that has been an issue since day one. 

If you have to swap to another app, even for a second, there is an 80-90% percent chance that the game will reboot when you swap back to it. 
Not only is this obnoxious and pace-killing, the game does not have anything in place to save where you were when it rebooted and load back into that save file. You will have lost / wasted that whole run and you will lose any progress on things you have unlocked during that run due to the game only checking for unlockables at the “game-over” screen. 

You will waste a lot of time and effort to this issue which is a shame considering it’s such a great game.

reviews.title: Can’t unlock Megalo/bugged
reviews.text: Can’t unlock Megalo Dracula in the new DLC. I reached level 80 I kill over 100,000 enemies and he does not unlock. This is a bug. It’s really annoying. If an update came out and it was fixed, I’d have no problem with five stars. I love this game. I’m just getting really irritated that some of the things I try to do you can’t do and I’m assuming because it’s mobile it would probably work fine on my PC, but I’m not about to rebuy the DLC for my PC. I prefer to play on my iPad.

reviews.title: Fantastic game but glaring issue
reviews.text: This game is great, so much better than the clones of it that have spawned on mobile, but one thing the clones do better is saving your progress mid run. It’s incredibly frustrating to switch to a different app for a few minutes to come back and see you’ve lost like 15-20 minutes of progress. I understand this isn’t originally a mobile game but as it’s on mobile now, it should be made to accommodate shorter playing sessions.

reviews.title: Gold Standard for IPhone Games
reviews.text: Other IOS developers need to take notes. This game takes me back to the golden age of app store games on my IPod touch. The goal was to make a quality product that above all else, is fun. Nowadays 9 out of 10 games have some sort of cash grab implemented and it is disgusting. It severely takes away from developers even caring about their games being fun anymore. This game does everything right.

reviews.title: The best in the ‘vs hoard’ genre
reviews.text:
Works with gamepads.  It’s a blast to start weak and grow powerful at a quick pace.  

My only complaint is that some goals are too cryptic so I’ve done everything except for 5 or 6 things that I don’t feel like sifting through guides and walkthroughs to learn what to do.

Definitely play this but know that you start out weak and lame.  You will have a blast once you unlock things.

reviews.title: Much love to the creator!
reviews.text: I overheard about this game through some page I follow on Facebook and decided to give it a shot on mobile. Upon learning that the creator decided to post this game for FREE (despite only being $3 or $4 on Steam) because there wasn’t a company that wouldn’t bombard it with *ADS*, I decided to buy this game in support on steam for myself and a few friends. Much love to you for making that step. A true homie.  Good luck to you!

reviews.title: Perfect port just in need one one thing…
reviews.text: Honestly I’m so happy this game made it to mobile properly, especially amid all the crappy ad-filled clones. Really the only thing that could theoretically improve the mobile version specifically would be a proper suspend/resume feature. Putting the app in the background works for short periods of time but a way to reliably pause a run for longer breaks would be insanely useful

reviews.title: THE O.G.!  (Hard to find?)
reviews.text:
I got lucky and just happened to stumble across an article that mentioned this release. I also play this on XSX and i can say with complete confidence that this should be THE STANDARD for all mobile ports. Great job, guys! 

*this doesn’t show up when i try to use the app store search bar. You should look into to that bc I’m sure ppl are chompin’ at the bit for this game, but they don’t have a clue that it’s out.

reviews.title: The og arena survival masterpiece
reviews.text: It’s vampire survivor on your phone, ignore the 1 star reviews. You don’t have to watch any ads if you don’t want to. If you get stuck on an ad hit the ? And it’ll reset the ad and let you continue. I noticed if I closed the app for more than 15 minutes sometimes it resets the app, it’s not that big of an issue though. Dev put in work to get this on mobile and make it non predatory

reviews.title: My game crashes a lot
reviews.text: So I have a lot of hours of this game on pc and I absolutely love this game. So when I heard that it was on mobile I was ecstatic, here’s the but. My game crashes a lot and i will be in the middle of the run and suddenly I’m back at my phones Home Screen. I’ve installed the game 3 different times and it still does it. I will update my review once I stop experiencing that problem because I do love the game but I would like to finish a single run at least

reviews.title: incredible
reviews.text: One of the greatest mobile games I’ve ever played. It just keeps getting better and better with every level and evolution. One issue I noticed was that if you get too strong and too many levels in a row (I got 30 in a row) I stopped choosing and tapped randomly. The game froze and I lost the run.😂 anyways fix that please and thanks for making this amazing game!

reviews.title: Great game! Needs a resume mechanic
reviews.text:
Love this game, no p2w and simple ads for a few extra bonuses like revives and gold that I would happily pay to remove.

The only thing missing on mobile is some sort of resume ability. These levels are long and there is nothing more frustrating than getting a FaceTime call or text and going back only to find that the game has kicked back to the start menu and all your progress was lost.

reviews.title: Incredible game!
reviews.text:
Beat the game once on my phone. Downloaded it to my iPad, and am playing through again with a PS4 controller. I wish more games had controller support like this does.

Best mobile game I’ve played in years. I think the best thing about games like this is figuring out how to break the game and be op in different ways. Wish you guys didn’t patch the overpowered Random character, that was so much fun lol 😅

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text:
As a PC gamer who can never find a truly satisfying mobile game, I have to say top marks on this one. Portrait mode a huge plus, simplistic but engaging game play, meaningful choices and progression. When I can’t play PoE this sates my desire t mow through mobs! 

My only criticism would be the inability to just pay you guys a one time fee (I would happily but this game for $5-10) in order to disable advertising. Consider it!

reviews.title: An Appreciation Message
reviews.text: I just want to start off with a thank you to Lucy and the support team; for listening, communicating, and then figuring out the problem with launching new saves for iOS. If you ever have a problem with your game or your save, don’t be afraid to email them and give them a heads up. My game is now working perfectly and I can’t wait to play more of it.

reviews.title: Best mobile game ever
reviews.text: This thing is the perfect boredom killer, Im addicted to trying to unlock everything, when I first opened it up I was kinda disappointed but oh was I wrong this game keeps growing and growing  with little secrets and unlocks and when your near the end of a run and your phone is lighting up like a Christmas tree, I just love it. And it’s free if you want even more there are dlcs. The game is great I’m done glazing.

reviews.title: My game keeps crashing when I try to play
reviews.text: So I had every thing unlock and all the power ups maxed except  seal one and I bought the new dlc so I could play it and once I bought it the game just kept crashing everytime I would load any map I even deleted and re downloaded the app getting rid of all my progress and it still crash can anyone help

reviews.title: This game was a fun mindless game… until…
reviews.text:
There’s a certain point when you are grinding to unlock more in the game, when you hit a sudden game changing experience. I don’t want to spoil it, but in a similar fashion to Noita, if you play JUST beyond the bounds of this game, you will find more to discover! 

Seriously, this game just got really cool and is now my favorite mobile game. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Great on iPhone, One Suggestion
reviews.text: Love this game! Have played hours on my PC through Steam and heard a podcaster get it for iPhone. Loving it so far. The only thing I wish it had the option for is to be able to auto move in the last direction you tell it to. Say you move left, your character keeps walking that way. That way you can pick up your finger to reposition every once in a while. Otherwise, everything is perfect!

reviews.title: Absolutely Phenomenal!!
reviews.text: I played this on PC when it first released and I loved it and now to have it on mobile for free is awesome!! And the fact that there are no ads pumped down your throat, as far as I’ve seen it’s the full game and the only ads are if you want a revive when you die! It’s incredible and I can’t give the devs enough credit for making it fully available!!

reviews.title: Please let me pay to remove video watching prompts
reviews.text:
This is the third platform I have Vampire Survivors (and all DLC) on, and I really love this game. But VS on Steam and the Switch let me pay $5 to not have ads or other plagues of mobile games. 

I get that mobile gaming is a terrible market, and basically no one is willing to pay for much of anything. But if you add an optional IAP so it doesn’t prompt me to watch videos, I will insta-buy that no-videos option.

reviews.title: Game is great with 1 glaring issue
reviews.text: The game is awesome. Super addictive and perfect for a phone. The only issue is that if you are in the middle of a run and switch apps you might lose all of your progress. This seems like a huge oversight when the game is on a phone and runs can last 30+ minutes. There needs to be some kind of workaround for this. It seems to be a very common complaint and really hurts the experience.

reviews.title: ADDS!!!! 🤢🤮
reviews.text: Beware of the add “enhanced” features of this game. You’re supposed to get a free revive for watching an add but many many many times more often than not, your run is over because the game revives you and keeps running in the background of the add, leaving your character helpless in the face of the onslaught. Then they have the nerve to ask you to watch yet another add to receive extra coins, only problem with that is it’s only a 20% bonus 😒 take that 30+ seconds to strategize and formulate your next run. Do not waste any time with the adds, they absolutely ruin an otherwise great game.

reviews.title: WARNING…VERY ADDICTIVE
reviews.text: I honestly almost deleted this game after a few minutes. There’s a little learning curve and no real instructions but not too hard to figure out. Now I’m totally hooked. Incredible game that I am now looking forward to playing for many many hours, days and weeks to come. Do yourself a favor and gibe this game a shot…you won’t be disappointed. \m/

reviews.title: Update fixed save data issue
reviews.text: This is a five star game that recently had an update that completely erased all of my saved data. But they issued a hot fix that fixed it, and now it's back! I'm very thankful, because I legitimately was going to be completely finished with the game after spending a year playing and having all the data gone.

reviews.title: Embarrassing mobile implementation
reviews.text:
Fun game but unfortunately hindered by critical flaws for mobile. Considering how much popularity and money this game’s made it’s just entirely unacceptable and I’m sorry to say it either lacks basic attention or motivation.

For a mobile game there’s no saving. I’d sometimes play 20min while I have the chance (kinda a huge point of mobile),
put it down and come back to it.  As soon as an hour later and firstly the game is completely unloaded and secondly there’s no save to remediate that issue. It’s bad enough to lose a run that was going well, but afaik it effectively wipes it from existence.

This is in contrast to other simple pixel art style mobile games across genres I’ve moved onto that for one seem to be able to stay loaded in memory just fine… even for a couple hours or so. Which leads me to believe this isn’t just a iOS garbage collection issue but an app issue. Secondly most a

reviews.title: Unplayable on iOS
reviews.text:
The game has no save feature. Since runs often take longer than half an hour and a lot of people on iOS frequently play in five minute stints. You either have to leave your phone with the app open and paused for hours until your next 5 minute play session, or you have to only play when you have more than half an hour to sit and play, which probably means you’re at home by a console or computer you’re going to play on instead. 

Otherwise, your runs will constantly be wiped when you lock your phone between play sessions, making it unplayable. 

I realize iOS is what closes apps due to inactivity, but that’s why most games I’ve played on iOS program a save/continue feature into their games so it’s accessible to iOS users that don’t have a half hour or more to just play on their phone. 

The game is amazing, I just wish I could play it on iOS.

reviews.title: Simple to play but very addictive
reviews.text: Gameplay is very intuitive and simple. The choices to make on level up depend luck and your play style. Many many characters to choose from with different stats, starting weapon and special abilities. If the player chooses to farm coins and golden eggs their favorite character can have their stats boosted endlessly. (With only character excempted)

reviews.title: Message to developers:)
reviews.text:
Just wanted to say that I hopped on this game after a year of not playing and I was very happy to see that there was plenty of new content and the game still felt fresh. I fell asleep with my phone in my hand on this game and woke up to my overheated phone…..I’m not even mad. 

I hope everyone connected to the creation of this game is doing great, thank you guys !

reviews.title: Great game, missing a continue feature.
reviews.text: Love the game, own it on pc. Many people don't have the time to continue a whole run and would love to put the game down and continue the same run on the next pick up. Would love to see a feature where you can continue your run. The other most popular survivor type game on here had that feature and was a bit confused when the official did not have it.

reviews.title: This game is the pinnacle of the genre it made!
reviews.text:
There are few words I can find to describe what a wonderful and fun experience this game so I will summarize it
Download, play, complete, delete, wait 2 years, download again, play again, complete again, delete again.
Rinse and repeat
And soon enough you’ll find a purpose in life
That being to play this game

reviews.title: A great mobile port
reviews.text: This is probably one of my favorite games this year. I should start with the negative, I’m not a fan of needing location data to use the game; regardless of the reason, and I would love for this to be removed. I’m willing to pay to remove this requirement. This is a perfect game for mobile because of its simple controls. It’s great on pc and it’s just as great on the phone. Give it a shot and you might get addicted like I did.

reviews.title: Neatly Converted…mostly
reviews.text: I’m not much of a completionist, but something about this game made me want to unlock all the things. I certainly got close, but a few of the PC to mobile shifts mean that if there’s a way to get certain secrets, I can’t figure it out. Sometimes you lose progress, which always hurts since the game sessions are pretty much locked into 30 minutes. Still fun overall, and doesn’t eat my battery as much as some games. Great for road trips without service.

reviews.title: Great game, needs autosaving
reviews.text: Loved this game on PC and it’s just as great on mobile. Plays great. My only complaint is that when I background the game to look at other apps, there’s like 50/50 chance the app will have closed when I go back and my run is lost. I understand the iOS memory constraints mean you have no control over the app closing but some sort of save during a run would be really helpful in this case.

reviews.title: Fun times
reviews.text: I’ve played this starting on of mostly on the steam deck. For whatever reason I find it better on mobile than on pc it’s much easier I’ve been able to complete almost everything on mobile vs pc I’m not sure if the game is made easier or is nerfed on mobile but it’s so much easier. Either way it’s very fun and a nice casual time waster.

reviews.title: Fix RESTARTING THE GAME
reviews.text: Please make the game so it doesn’t reset after leaving the app. There’s so many of these games where you leave and come back and the game asks “would you like resume”. I played another rouge survival after 2 years and the game asked if I wanted to play where I left off at. As much popularity and this game has got, you can’t just add a feature that’s in almost every Mobile game? I had a run for over 30 min and lost all progress bc I left for 5 min. PLEASE FIX THIS

reviews.title: Basic game fun but terrible add system
reviews.text:
Worst kind of ads. They tell you you got your rewards granted, but they keep dragging it out longer and longer it’s painful. I’d rather just pay 10 bucks if they ever allow you to get rid of the ads I’ll go to five stars.

OK lowered it to two stars. I got a new iPad because my old one broke and when I transferred the save game, I lost everything. And I’ve been playing a long time not only that it wiped out the same game. Terrible system too bad looking for another game like it that’s better.

reviews.title: Fun But Annoying Crashes
reviews.text: I’ve put a lot of time into this game on multiple platforms. The one problem I have with this version is it constantly crashes if you have to pause and switch apps for a moment or just allow the screen to go black after pausing. It doesn’t restore the run you were just on so you’ll probably waste a lot of time.

reviews.title: Broken game
reviews.text:
Game resets itself if you have to use your phone. Will waste your time with gaining gold as the Character prices go up each round. ie. Menya was 215,001. I played a round to get that much gold. When the Round ended Menya was 220,00, next round Menya was 225,000. Game purposely keeps you trapped from gaining characters. 
I’ve had multiple instances of the game resetting and losing all gold and achievements gained. Very frustrating. Could be a great game but the flaws are hard to ignore. Especially for a game that wants to keep you occupied for 15-30 minutes.

reviews.title: Game constantly crashes after buying new Foscari DLC
reviews.text: So normally my game would only crash to insanely heavy things happening like running a gold run for way too long but now it crashes very easily. After uniting to Spellstring, cast, and spell thing the game instantly crashes. The final boss of the game now crashes at the part where many things happen on screen when it used to not. Now I can’t even do a gold run cause it crashes before even 7 minutes.

reviews.title: A game that doesn’t waste your time or money.
reviews.text:
It’s a genuine miracle to find a mobile game that isn’t actively trying to take advantage of you.  Ironically this game that doesn’t require you to pay a cent or watch tons of ads is developed by a person who originally only designed actual physical casino games.

A game that is good at what it does and isn’t lying to you. AKA. Perfect

reviews.title: 2D GOTY 2022 is here and somehow it’s free!?
reviews.text: It’s lacking a couple of things from the desktop version, the most notable to me right now being the inability to filter out completed unlocks from the massive list. I would also really really like to be able to have cloud saves between my iPhone and iPad as having to have two saves on mobile is kinda much.

reviews.title: Perfect (except for crashes)
reviews.text: I completed the game and waited patiently for the DLC to come out. I was excited to complete the new challenges, but the game crashes pretty consistently around 20-25 minutes on Bat Country. The last 6 times I’ve tried to complete that level, the same thing occurs. I’ve tried looking online, and while I see others with a similar issue, I haven’t found many solutions.

reviews.title: All the polish of the PC game without the price
reviews.text: Let me start off by saying, I wish the developer included IAPs, but not for anything besides supporting them for such a fantastic game. The Best Indie Debut nominee gets ported to mobile for free? And the ads aren’t invasive or overused? It seems too good to be true, but it’s even better on mobile than PC. The portrait orientation is perfect for on-the-go games. Honestly a breath of fresh air

reviews.title: A Refreshing Title on the App Store
reviews.text: A wonderful game with a tight loop. Simple to start, but nuanced in its ability to grow as you get better. No pesky micro transactions, which is a massive win for me, and you have the chance to watch ads in exchange for a revive. I can work with that. It also works in offline mode so I can play it on a plane. 6/5 stars. Bought for the pc as well.

reviews.title: The hype is real
reviews.text: I had heard a lot of good things about vampire survivors from the pc crowd. Never tried it before it dropped on iOS. Went in thinking it’ll probably be one of those mediocre games that get hyped up for some obscure inconceivable reason. Got humbled real quick. This game slaps! And to have it in your pocket.. needless to say productivity has taken a huge dive. Highly recommended!

reviews.title: Be careful with this one
reviews.text: Seriously. You’ll be saying to yourself “one more round,” only for you to look up at the clock moments later to realize that hours have somehow passed. A deceptively simple, yet amazing game. As of writing this, there are no predatory monetization tactics at play. The only complaint I have is that the Analytics Opt-Out button doesn’t seem to do anything.

reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.text: I am often surprised where I find these stand-out games. This is worth your time. It’s accessible, easy to jump in, and values your time. So far I really appreciate the f2p model. It has ads, but they are designed into the game well and never present during gameplay. The controls are excellent. I worried about touch vs gamepad but it’s on-par with diablo immortal for sleekness.

reviews.title: 5 star game? No, 500 star game
reviews.text: Cannot fvvking believe this game is free. If I paid $5 for this game I would still feel like I found a hidden gem. Started playing on PC but it’s better on mobile. Absolute gem of a game, can only think of one SINGLE other mobile game I’ve enjoyed as much as this and it’s been off the App Store for years. So Vampire Survivors firmly holds the crown

reviews.title: This is not roguelike
reviews.text:
I know that there are many of these swarm killing games that claim to be roguelike, but it is a lie. There is nothing roguelike about this game. The levels are preset, you choose your characters. The items are in predetermined locations. There no reason to pretend this is in the same realm as rogue, or slay the spire, or anything in that genre.

Besides that, I enjoy the game, just don’t turn off your screen or the game might reset and you lose 20 minutes of gameplay

reviews.title: Masterpiece
reviews.text: If there was ever a phone game that could easily take over my brain it’d be this one.  Who knew holding my thumb on one side of the screen or the other could be so fun!  I didn’t think I’d spend hours on this game looking for secrets (and maybe vampires?) let alone mostly completing it.  If your looking for a time killer you’ve found your game

reviews.title: Great game needs fixes
reviews.text: Like the title says this game is great. Fun and quick. Plenty to do. However this game crashes too much. The new dlc character I can’t use because once I activate his synergy the game crashes. I can’t do the bat country level because once I reach the 15 minute mark it crashes. Incredibly frustrating in this otherwise fantastic game. Hopefully this gets fixed sooner than later.

reviews.title: An instant classic you can sink dozens of hours in
reviews.text: The console/steam version of this game has been flawlessly ported onto mobile, and it absolutely slaps. Because there is just so much content. What seems super basic on the surface level becomes insanely deep, with tons of weapons, evolutions of those weapons, and over 40 unique characters. It’s wild and you need to give it a try

reviews.title: The original and still the best
reviews.text: Yeah, there's a billion clones of this game on the appstore but none of them compare to the quality of the original. One of the most addictive roguelites out there. Can't wait for the ability to link our saves here with the ones on steam, 'cause it's kinda painful replaying the earlygame after having beat the game already 😅.

reviews.title: Great Fun
reviews.text: This game takes me back, back to when iOS games didn’t make you watch ads every 2 minutes, when games were made purely for fun. Absolutely love this game. Best thing about it is the battery efficiency. I played for over an hour on my 13 Pro Max and it only used 2% of battery. Almost unheard of these days. Thank you for this amazing game.

reviews.title: Please Release Account Sync!
reviews.text: This game is amazing. One of the craziest lightning in a bottle I’ve ever seen. It’s just perfect. It’s as good as every other version. You don’t lose out on anything. But PLEASE give us the account sync system that has been in beta forever! I love the game but I want to keep progressing and not start over on each new system.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Bought the dlcs 100% the game and have over 3k eggs on red death i would like more but i would just cheese them with red death thankyou for the great game maybe make more game modes like one where you spawn with a random character and loadout or something so i cant use the same method everytime or something to keep us wanting to play after 100%

reviews.title: Download it and play it now
reviews.text: Just a fair warning this game is detective and it’s for free you pay once and that’s it. There’s a few DLC I would highly recommend them. They’re also very cheap. This game is extremely fun and addictive in a good way. I played it almost on every single console and device I have and unlocked everything.

reviews.title: So good
reviews.text: I’ve never written a review in my life but this game is a breath of fresh air from greedy game companies especially on mobile just plaguing their games with ads and IAP but this game has none of that, and it’s honestly the only game I’ve found interesting in years, the dev did such a great job I can’t think of anything negative about this game at all

reviews.title: Thanks developers
reviews.text: Shout out to the developers for not riddling this game with any ads. Only ones in the game are ones you want to watch. Then not to mention the games a blast. Not a game you can squeeze in during a quick break, but I got different games for that. Nice breath of fresh air for the mobile games not being nothing but ad ridden cash grabs. Thanks!

reviews.title: Free, no ads, and much better than all the ripoffs
reviews.text: A challenging but fair game that rewards exploration around the surprising amount of maps and stylistically just outshines all the other swarm games that came out after the pc version of this. Love it and doesn’t interrupt gameplay to show 2 30 second unskippable ads like EVERY OTHER MOBILE GAME love it!

reviews.title: Love this game
reviews.text:
Was excited to see this game on mobile. 

Only reason four stars is that every time you level up it can be pretty difficult to pick up your momentum and direction again with touch screens after your selection. I’ve lost more health to leveling than much else while getting started. If I find a way to overcome that quirk it’s easily a 5 star game.

reviews.title: My favorite game right now!
reviews.text: I’m absolutely loving this game! The only thing I can complain about is the fact that if I leave the game open in the background for too long, it will kick me out of whatever round I’m in. I’d love to see the ability to resume games in the future. Other than that, Vampire Survivors is 100% worth the install!

reviews.title: Amazing game but crashes often.
reviews.text: This game is an incredible value - free to play with DLC content that is priced fairly.  I can’t oversell it as one of the best games of its type.  The only flaw is it will sometimes crash if too much is happening and you lose all your progress.  I hope the developers are able to fix this issue as it’s the only reason I don’t rate it at 5 stars.

reviews.title: Please fix crash/reset bug when minimizing app
reviews.text: I love this game and this is a great port, but I have lost several good runs 20+ minutes in because I minimized the app to answer a text or something real quick and the app crashed/reset to main menu when I went back to it. I didn’t close the app, I simply tabbed out. It’s pretty heartbreaking to have this happen to runs I’m invested in.

reviews.title: Amazing port
reviews.text: I own the game on both xbox and pc, I’ve always enjoyed it, but I knew we needed a mobile port. So, during the game awards, I checked the App Store to download one of the mobile games they mentioned, and out of nowhere, vampire survivors shows up, no warning, no announcement , nothing. Already played 7 hours. I was getting so sick of playing the bad ripoffs.

reviews.title: Perfect game, but may I suggest…
reviews.text:
1) An option in the pause menu that allows players to toggle on/off equipped weapons, as to better navigate the screen once umpteen weapons are evolved.

2) a scrolling stat menu during pause mode. About half the stat bar goes off the bottom of the screen once the character starts getting really developed.

3) A create and customize mode for more personalized characters. Maybe with some kind of earned point system.😃

These ideas have been rolling around the family for a couple weeks now. My boys and I play on either the PS5, one of two switches, an iPad and my iPhone. Keep up the good work!

reviews.title: Question
reviews.text: It has been a pleasure to play this game, the stages are well-developed and the challenges are quite challenging! Thanks for making it! Are there going to be more updates on the characters and power-ups?  My skills have been maxed out, and I have received O'sole, along with 12 other characters. Thank you very much for the game.

reviews.title: Great Game - Option to Remove Ads Please
reviews.text:
This is a fantastic game! I’ve played hours and hours on PC and this is a good mobile port. 

The only negative so far… please provide the option to remove ads. Many would happily pay for the game, and it's much better to play without the ads prompts (note this doesn’t affect the level game play, minus a revive option for watching an add, so far that I’ve seen)

reviews.title: Check the setting!
reviews.text:
You can totally play this gem (ha!) in landscape by going into the settings. As of now, it also works with a backbone controller. 

First time playing this game after being hassled by friends to try it. It’s rather rocks hard and it’s mind blowing it’s free. If your looking for a weird retro/modern game that’s a love letter to the idea of Castlevania, like, super look no more.

reviews.title: Big issue PLEASE FIX
reviews.text:
Cannot save and continue run. Sometimes I get a phone call or happen to accidentally lock my phone and then the whole 15 minute run will end without the ability to continue. I have had great runs ends because the game had minimized for less than a minute. 

I hope there is something being made to fix this in the future. Until then, I do not feel like wasting anymore time.

reviews.title: Free ,no ads..
reviews.text:
I don’t know why  a-lot of pol complaining with this game, i played on my ps and mobile, and i never have any issue with it (i’m using iphone 15 pro)and compare to other free games..the dev never force you to spend real money throughout the game (they even give the DLC for free) 
lowkey i recommend this game to anyone if you like rogueplay game

reviews.title: LOVE IT
reviews.text:
This is one of my favorite games in the world. Not JUST super fun, but has tons of personality, tons of content and secrets and even more on the steam version (DLC!)
Honestly makes me angry to see all the knockoffs already popping up. But I guess that means your game really made it big. Congrats to everyone who worked on this game for making something this special.

reviews.title: Bug Midgame for iOS version
reviews.text: Candelabrador did not unlock when I leveled Santa water to 4. I’ve accomplished it at least five times. I’ve been working on it for a week, and I just learned it’s a bug that wasn’t patched for iOS. It prevents me from being able to use a game item critical for my build. I hope this bug does not exist on the copy I bought on my game console. Besides I use my iPhone more than my console. Please fix this ASAP.

reviews.title: My Game of the Year - Brilliant
reviews.text:
Can’t say enough good things about this game. The controls are excellent. The progression is tuned to perfection—there’s always something to work toward, and the power curve is completely satisfying. There’s a ton of content. The ads are beneficial, unobtrusive, and completely optional. 

This is an instant classic. The devs should be beyond proud of this achievement. Well done!

reviews.title: I never leave reviews
reviews.text: I play tons of mobile games and I never leave reviews, much less a 5* rating but the developers earned it on this one. With so many mobile versions of games just money hungry I must say well done with this game. Looking forward to anything these developers do in the future.

reviews.title: Problems’ problems :(
reviews.text: Ok this is one of the best games I’ve ever played there’s just one issue, I can use the polis map on the polis levels, and I can’t see the things that can guide me to like the engineer. reviews.title: Stellar game, wish it had a continue button
reviews.text: The game is amazing, literally the only thing that keeps it from being a 5 star for me is that I don’t always have a straight 30 minutes to commute to a single play sess.  It kinda stinks giving up all the progress on a 25 minute session because I had to put it down for an hour or two.

reviews.title: From Damien the best game
reviews.text: I love the game and the qualities and affects you put a lot of effort to this game I love it keep doing all the hard work I spent hard hard hard days to get all these characters you earn a five  stars really fun game keep playing the game and have fun maybe on Christmas I will get the Maps cause I really love this game bye :by Damian

reviews.title: Surviving, No Vampires
reviews.text: Found this game on Steam when it first released last year. At first it seems dumb but they understand how to make a gameplay loop that keeps you coming back. Each run only lasts up to 30 minutes but majority of people will take a good few dozen to complete the 30 minutes.

reviews.title: DLC Unavailable
reviews.text: I reached out to support about this issue and have yet to hear a response: I got the free Emeralds DLC from the in-game store, but it keeps saying “DLC Unavailable” when I boot the game up. Keeps saying to check my internet connection. I’ve had good WiFi and good signal and it continues to do this. Please fix this issue.

reviews.title: Absolutely phenomenal game
reviews.text: I would like to note that on occasion, the Royal match ad doesn't close before revive. And also that limit breaking pentagram only run with silent sanctuary can actually glitch if you try to fight one of the ring bosses. Honestly though, what a fantastic game. Will def be doing the dlc once I finish the rest of what's free

reviews.title: A perfect game, and a near-perfect port
reviews.text:
This is one of my favorite games of all time, and I’ve been dying for a mobile port after the first day I played it. Everything translates just great, and I’ve had a blast since release. 

The ONLY thing that I’d like to see added is some sort of haptic/vibration feedback when taking damage. It’s a great addition for those playing without sound.

reviews.title: Fantastic game, hoping for QoL updates
reviews.text: My coworker got me onto this game and it is utterly fantastic. My only concern is that I can’t swap profiles between say my phone and my tablet which would be awesome to be able to do some point in the future. But for what this is as a time wasting app on your mobile device. It is amazing and great fun!

reviews.title: highly recommend
reviews.text: this fits all my personal criteria for a game, top down pixel art, skill based playing that turns into an idle game if you upgrade the right way. Extremely unobtrusive optional ads. i would’ve paid a couple bucks for this considering that it’s a full game in itself.

reviews.title: Endlessly replayable
reviews.text: This is the game that started all those similar clones that you see on the App Store and from its vast range of upgrades and abilities, a variety of different stages to endlessly face off hordes, countless different characters with an old man and his trusty garlic (wink wink) , there is so much content and variety that you’ll be dying happily for dozens of hours. DOWNLOAD NOW.

reviews.title: No save? Leave app and it resets!
reviews.text: A 5/5 star game. Leveling is fun, characters. Love mowing down hordes of enemies. SO FRUSTRATING that I set my phone down for two minutes after pausing the game, phone locks, and it restarts you? Right back to main menu. All progress lost. What? For a game that requires you to survive for 30 minutes to not have some sort of auto-save feature or feature which suspends your gameplay is a little ridiculous. Add that and my review would be 5/5.

reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: This is an amazing game, better than any of the other “survivor” clones on the store. My only gripe is that I lose my progress in the middle of a run if I leave leave the app in the background for a bit when needing to do other things. This should be addressed since each complete run is 30 minutes. Otherwise, this is a solid game!

reviews.title: Ads break the game
reviews.text: Love the game and won’t lower the stars about this, but watching an ad for bonus gold or a revive freezes the game, destroying all the gold you made that round. It’s happened twice now and has made me never want to click the ad button again. Maybe that’s intentional?

reviews.title: Good, but problematic.
reviews.text: I like the game, it seems fun and I’ve seen YouTubers play it. The problem is that I can’t have the app open for more than 15 minutes before the whole thing crashes. I tried turning off everything I could, like damage numbers, but it doesn’t help. This means that I cant even finish a game before it crashes. Please do something to fix this, or tell me what to do about it.

reviews.title: DLC is limited time ?
reviews.text: I’ve been a fan of this game for awhile and when I found out the DLC hit mobile I bought it instantly. I played it the first day but after closing the app for a little bit then attempting to open it back up later has seemed to disable everything DLC related. I can’t access any of the content related to it and the only trace of it is the Unlocked count being 149 out of 145 since I had gotten 4 achievements before I had logged out

reviews.title: Peak Game
reviews.text:
I am lazy about writing reviews in general, but this one deserves it.

Absolutely 10/10

I am hooked. What a game. So much quality and love poured into it. Really makes my iPhone feel like a handheld gaming device when I’m consumed by this! Thank you for making it.

ONE complaint:

WHY ON EARTH is there a black bar at the bottom of the screen always?! I imagine it is a relic from a time of thinking that people will only be using their thumbs at the chin of the phone for joystick / movement… but we don’t! My fingers move all around the screen, why isn’t this game fullscreen?! Why the faint black bar?! :’(

reviews.title: Amazing game 4 out of 5 (no controller support)
reviews.text:
I’m playing this game on iOS and Xbox Cloud Gaming. On iOS it doesn’t support a controller and it’s still fun but way harder to play. On Xbox Cloud Gaming it supports a controller and is so much better, but the trade off is the game is streaming and struggles while playing over cell phone service.
Also cross save would be put this game into game of the decade category.

reviews.title: Wonderful port!
reviews.text:
Controls great, plays just like the PC version.

PLEASE add feature to cache your current run state when the app suspends, nothing worse than being 20 minutes into a great run, have to take a phone call or look something up, and coming back to the title screen.

reviews.title: This game needs a save function
reviews.text: I wish there was a way to save a run. Sometimes I would exit the app to reply a message or something, come back and the app is already closed and the run completely gone. That would allow much more playability for me.

reviews.title: so glad it’s finally on mobile!
reviews.text:
i’ve loved this game for a while and basically maxed it out in pc and it’s SO nice to see it’s on mobile for FREE no less, especially since there has been a certain other game on here that pretty blatantly copied VS. 

it’s such good quality and would recommend it to anyone !

reviews.title: Underrated
reviews.text: It’s rare I actually complete games and so far I’ve done it twice with this one on steam and now here. Nothing but praise for the developers as well for making a free game that isn’t loaded down with ads and extra purchases. They made a good game and put it out there for people to enjoy.

reviews.title: Love this game
reviews.text: I have bought this game and all the DLC on Switch, IOS and Xbox. I absolutely do not approve or like ads in the IOS version. I don't care if they are optional they should not be in the game at all. I just bought all the DLC yesterday on IOS and it's been years since I have played this version. If I knew they had ads in the game or the option to play ads I would have never bought the DLC. I will not be buying another Poncle game on IOS due to this. Ads should not be in a premium game you paid for.

reviews.title: Love the game…but
reviews.text: They need to fix the game crashing when I resume after switching apps or putting my phone to sleep. It’s super annoying to be 20 minutes into a run, step away, and come back to find it crashed and I have to start over. Otherwise, the game is awesome, and I hope to see more DLC in the future.

reviews.title: Vampire Survivors changed my life
reviews.text: This amazing game brought me back from the brink of a major depressive episode. Just when I was about to give up hope of ever being happy again, along comes vampire survivors. Wow, what a life changing experience it is playing this game. Gone are my sad feelings, hopelessness. Thanks Vampire Survivors.

reviews.title: One issue
reviews.text: Game is great and feels exactly like the pc version. That being said can we see a link accounts option in the future, for example linking pc to mobile so you have the same items and everything this will also help with the dlc because some people might not want to buy it twice.

reviews.title: Love the graphics, sounds, gameplay.
reviews.text: Just wish there was more “oomph” and content to it. It gets repetitive after a bit and easy to beat. Could definitely use more unique mobs that force you to recognize challenges in the form of patterns.

reviews.title: PLEASE PUT IN SAVE STATES..
reviews.text: Save states are a MUST.  Especially being on mobile. Sometime i have to put my phone down or do something else on my phone real quick.  I cant tell you how many times i have play a 20 min game and left the app to come back & its reloading the menu.. closing out my game and rebooting the app.  This is easily a 5 star game but with this flaw it makes playing it on mobile almost impossible, unless you can dedicate the whole 30min uninterrupted.  On a phone, that’s not always possible.

reviews.title: No cloud saves really stinks
reviews.text: This game is a masterpiece I have it on steam and prefer it there only because I feel my progress is more safeguarded there. Please bring cloud saves on mobile! Charge the 4.99 for the game or make skins or something if you need $$ for it but the cloud saves are a must for a game like this

reviews.title: Starts slow but then OMG!!!! Maelstrom of carnage
reviews.text:
This game is crazy addictive and more depth than I realized.  After patiently leveling character and learning how the basic abilities work you are rewarded with insane action.  

Developer: how do I give you money for this gem?!  Please port to AppleTV so I can use controller and enjoy big screen!

reviews.title: Great game broken by DLC
reviews.text:
DLC is constantly redownloading itself or downloading updates off slow servers. Even in the same day game takes 5 ~15 min to load each time I open it so it can download DLC updates. If internet is not available,  all DLC content disappears. Brought my go to game for trips to completely useless. 
Seems devs turned from user centered to money centered, would rather break game for users through endless downloads and reverifications than risk not making all the cash they can.

reviews.title: achievements do not register as completed
reviews.text: Great game to play when you’re on a car ride or waiting for time to pass by, but there are a couple bugs, such as some achievements not being completed even though they were done or some weapons not functioning correctly.

reviews.title: Bruh
