Other than that I think this is a great game

reviews.title: EASILY the best game on mobile
reviews.text: Been playing for weeks now and it’s easy to spend hours playing this game. Reminds me of the binding of Isaac greed mode. Lots of cool builds and characters and an awesome variety of stages and modes to play. Please consider donating to the dev’s if you can. Credit is due where credit is earned 🖤

reviews.title: Saved my marriage
reviews.text: My wife was with her boyfriend who was playing survivor io, well, when she told me about the game and how she wanted to play it, I had to sit her down and show her the magic of vampire survivors, after hearing the truth and being enlightened, she threw so much garlic at her boyfriend that he died of suffocation

reviews.title: Great game but needs improvement

There are some minor improvements I would like to see like the UI for the items you squired being too small to see and I would live it if I could play the game holding my phone horizontally as an option

reviews.title: Constantly crashes
reviews.text:
I love this game on PC and bought it, the contents are all good, except for two things:

reviews.title: not a survivor copy
reviews.text: before any of you say this is a knockoff and copy of the app game survivor, it’s not. This game has been released on steam years before survivor even existed. They just decided to move it to the App Store. I love this game so much, it has so much depth and I’m so happy they moved it to iPhone as well.

reviews.title: Just waiting on DLC
reviews.text: Finished all achievements and secrets on mobile. And I enjoyed it so much I decided to do it all over again on PC, just so I can eventually play the DLC. I know they’re working on a way to bring the DLC to mobile, but I don’t wanna really wait. That’s how much fun I’m having with it.

reviews.title: I Keep Coming Back
reviews.text: Games like these are like a diamond - so good that I am compelled to 100% it, and then STILL keep coming back to play more! Perfect for a quick hit of dopamine, and always so satisfying to try different combos of characters, weapons, and Arcana abilities on different runs.

reviews.title: Game saving
reviews.text: Hey I played this game a lot but the most annoying part was exiting the app and then angering to find that I lost all of my progress in a map. If you could add that one little feature to the game it would make my experience so much more exciting. Just a thought. Other than that I would rate fhis game 5 stars

reviews.title: Great game but needs save feature
reviews.text: The game is very fun and addictive but it takes 30mins to beat a level and if you go to a different app for too long while your game is paused like to respond to a text or take a call it will reset the app and all of your progress will be lost. This game NEEDS a quit and save feature

reviews.title: Great except
reviews.text: Please add an option to pay a one time fee to remove any mention of ads. I am so tired of games with ads. I would pay though to remove them and turn it into just a great game. Or apply to put the game in Apple Arcade and maybe make some better buttons. Otherwise the game itself is super fun.

reviews.title: Love it but lose progress on games
reviews.text:
It’s a great game and I love playing it on steam.
Only issue is I’ve lost progress multiple times as this is a game I pick up when I have some free time and set down when I’m busy. I wish it would save game state often so you don’t lose progress of a game when you’re in the middle of it.

reviews.title: only one flaw
reviews.text: It consistently crashes when i get past 5 minutes. i cant ever get a 30 minute run because of this. i hope it can be fixed because this game is amazing and i want to progress more :)

reviews.title: New favorite game, endless replayability
reviews.text: This game has it all, easy gameplay, easy mechanics, fun, frenetic action packed levels. Tons of secrets, unlockables, characters and wealons. Endless variety and replayabiity depending how you build your character and which you choose. And its all free, DEVS you nailed it on this one!

reviews.title: Fun, beautifully made masterpiece
reviews.text: OMG……. I love this so much you don’t even KNOW. First of all, it’s available on Nintendo( not ALL Nintendo consoles) , computer (not sure which), and mobile devices. Second, it has a timer so when I personally see it I like to set goals. Third it’s just so fun!!!!

reviews.title: Frozen player bug
reviews.text:
There seems to be a bug where after defeating a boss and opening the treasure chest, the player is temporarily frozen and can’t be moved onscreen. 

It only lasts a moment, but in that moment enemies get closer, it makes the game little bit more frustrating, especially when low on health

reviews.title: Do NOT watch ads to revive
reviews.text: Lost two of my best runs to the magic the gathering ad not letting me out after. Waited for well over 2-3 mins. Minimized and re-opened app… touched the screen everywhere for a hidden X or maybe it would take me to the App Store and then let me through. Nothing worked and when I closed the game I came back and find that I received no reward for the run.

reviews.title: I love this game but it brings back ad memories
reviews.text: My streamer friend doctor Ezekiel, used to love this game he would play it all the time, and he 100% it so many times I remember we turned it into a competition on who can 100% it first. He sadly passed away from a heart attack tho:(

reviews.title: Needs a resume run feature
reviews.text: Great game. The only reason it isnt 5 stars is because when you leave the game and try to come back to it you lose all the progress you made for that run. In almost every game this style on IOS has this feature so it’s not really excusable this game doesn’t.

reviews.title: Far exceeded expectations
reviews.text: This game is amazing! Highly rewarding to players and unbelievably has no in game payments! No adds! Just beautiful game that handles hordes of enemies which ease and keeps you interested with unreal amounts of stuff to unlock. But not all at once so that you don’t get overwhelmed. This is exceptional.

reviews.title: I’m confused
reviews.text: I like this game, but I’m deleting it. When I went to delete it and see if it had any cache left on my ram or any data my iPhone wouldn’t let me. Only gave me one choice, delete. Is this because you don’t use cache or storage?

reviews.title: Disappointing….
reviews.text: I’ve been having a couple of issues as far as starting up the app. Why does it keep redownloading the new stages every few times as soon as I start the game??? And why does it slow down during the gameplay? It’s been happening a lot and it’s not fun to play anymore! I like this game but it definitely has issues! Now, I can’t even finish the game without crashing and kicking me out!!!! Unbelievable and ridiculous!

reviews.title: Awesome game
reviews.text:
Probably my most played iOS game. Extremely addicting- I just wish there was more content

It is a little buggy on iOS compared to steam

Those cross powerups that kill everything on screen sometimes do too good a job and cause enemies to no longer spawn, basically ending your game

Sometimes the enemies will all freeze in place and stop spawning too 

Highly recommend playing tho- no predatory iap like most other games have now

(though I wish I could pay a one-time fee to get rid of the watch-ads-for-revive button. Buttons like that just take me out of the game)

reviews.title: Very fun game
reviews.text: I have this on console as well and have put many many hours into this game. Now that it’s on mobile it’s perfect and fun to start all over again. Highly recommend to anyone that just wants a chill game that passes time

reviews.title: Fix the repeating DLC download issue!
reviews.text:
Edit after most recent update: still no fix to the issue with losing DLC or playing the DLC offline.  It gets blown after a couple days. Maybe the next update…

Edit after last update: 
Losing DLC is still an issue. The download seems to persist for less than a few days before it says there is no DLC and it needs to be downloaded. 

I see this game is being advertised as something that can be played offline. That isn’t the case with the DLC though. That is unfortunate.
————————————————

I thought the complaints were user error, but they are not. I can’t think of any other app that does this with their DLC.  Pretty sloppy actually. I decided to buy this here versus on Steam, but I guess I made a mistake.

reviews.title: Love this game, might be one of the best!
reviews.text: I'm thrilled with this game! Initially challenging, it gets more enjoyable as unlocks and power-ups ease the experience. Discovering strategies and completing tasks keeps it endlessly engaging. My only suggestion is to clarify level unlocking criteria. Overall, a perfect 10/10 for me!

reviews.title: Great game, with issues
reviews.text: Honestly a fun time waster, my only issues are the ads to revive wasting my time.  Nearly everytime I opt to deal with an ad to revive an attempt that was going good it will fire the game up while the ad is still locking me into watching.  Now I’m still dead but wasted time with the worst ads ever.

reviews.title: Fantastic game
reviews.text: Absolutely love this game. Spent countless hours on the PC version. My one wish is that they would offer the ability to pay to disable ads. Other than that, this game is the best of the best when it comes to “survivor” type games.

reviews.title: Still the best even after 2 years
reviews.text:
It’s a simple game that’s hard to explain how amazing it is. The fact that it’s free on mobile is hilarious as this is one of the best ways to play the game.
Don’t look for depth, look for a casually relaxing good time.

reviews.title: Game has crashing problems
reviews.text: I very much enjoy this game, but the game keeps crashing around 20~ minutes on the iPhone XR, it isn’t capable of running the game past that and it isn’t saving my gold after it crashes :(

reviews.title: SAVE GAME OPTION!
reviews.text: As a phone game that takes 30 minutes to complete there should be a “save game” feature for when something comes up and you can’t complete the game. If it was not for this app not having this feature it would be 5 stars.

reviews.title: I want the dlc!

reviews.title: Hail to the Flash-esque games!

reviews.text:

reviews.title: Worth it.

reviews.title: Fantastic time killer…

reviews.title: Keeping it simple makes it fun

reviews.title: Game Too Good
reviews.text: This game is fun and keeps you interested, offering hours upon hours of replayablility, with one frustrating flaw. It’s free! It would make sense if this game cost 5-10 dollars, but this just feels wrong. Devs, raise the price! I can’t keep playing with this guilt.

reviews.title: Don’t fall for the fakers. This is the real deal
reviews.text: Amazing. Everything an app should be. To everyone on the development team: thank you. Thank you for sticking to your principles. Thank you for this creation. No scams. No money grabs. Pure story and fun.  From the too often silent majority, thank you.

reviews.title: Addictive Once You Get The Ball Rolling

reviews.title: Please

Please saving will make this game perfect!!!!

reviews.title: The OG Survivors Game
reviews.text:
This game invented a brand new genre of video games: the “survivor” genre. Thanks to this game, we got a lot of other good games like DRG Survivors which is also on the App Store. 

I imported my save from my PC and bam! I got all my unlocks, which is ALL of them, allowing me to enjoy this game on my phone for a casual quick run on the go. 

I didn’t get all the DLCs though despite owning them all on steam but this is the only flaw. 

Thanks poncle. I’mma buy the crawlers game when it comes out in ~a week or so.
